item.title: A weekly dashboard for every clinic
item.description:
Every clinic on Lumen now gets a weekly dashboard showing how many patients finished intake before arrival and how much documentation time it saved.

Find it under Reports.

item.title: What we learned measuring which clinics grow
item.description: We tracked which clinics grow fastest after switching to Lumen, and the clearest signal was sending the intake link the day before the visit.

item.title: Intake in Vietnamese and Tagalog
item.description: Patients can now answer intake questions in Vietnamese and Tagalog, and clinicians still read the structured note in English.
